title: Apache httpd
description: Workers, connections and requests from server-status?auto of Apache httpd (mod_status), inside module_targets, module_hosts and module_ports of agent.toml (by default loopback, localhost and the services' ports).

url.title: Status URL
url.description: The server-status location with ?auto, e.g. http://127.0.0.1/server-status?auto.

tls_verify.title: Verify TLS certificates
tls_verify.description: For an https URL; off only for self-signed certificates you can't give as a CA file.

ca_file.title: CA file
ca_file.description: PEM file below module_file_prefixes to verify with instead of the system's CAs.
